claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from April 23–25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft takes place on the North Shore near Acrisure Stadium.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday.
Rounds 2–3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday.
Rounds 4–7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday.
The 2026 NFL Draft features a shortened eight-minute pick timer for the first round.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft starts at 8 p.m. Eastern on Thursday, April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft start at 7 p.m. Eastern on Friday, April 24.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft start at 12 p.m. Eastern on Saturday, April 25.
The 2026 NFL Draft is free to attend.
Festivities of the 2026 NFL Draft are centered around Point State Park.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on NFL Network.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ESPN.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ABC
